name: Overseer
summary: Runs and shows your coding agents' work queue and its schedules: tasks, logs, the morning report and a Pick-up job from your agent boards.
description: Wraps the agent-queue and orchestrator.sh scripts on the machine where your coding agents (Claude Code) run, over SSH. The page shows the queue (running, pending and the last finished tasks, each with its log and its issue and pull request links), lets you add a task, cancel one, pause the queue or run a job now, and shows the latest morning report. Four schedules (stall check, morning report, lessons, Pick-up) run as Automaton scheduled actions that you can pause or change in Studio. Pick-up queues the open issues in the Ready for agents column of each board you list, in order, skips those that need shape, and queues nothing when no board is set. It never merges, releases or touches production itself: that stays in the task prompts and skills of your agents.

application.description: Shows and runs your coding agents' work queue and its schedules.

arguments: python -m py_compile main.py overseer.py && mkdir -p .pip-tmp && TMPDIR=$PWD/.pip-tmp pip install --quiet --cache-dir .pip-tmp/cache --target dist/lib 'paramiko>=3,<5' && rm -rf .pip-tmp && mkdir -p dist/ui && cp main.py overseer.py index.html overseer.js overseer.css dist/ && cp ui/app.css ui/app.js dist/ui/

settings.name: QUEUE_HOST
settings.description: user@address of the machine where agent-queue runs and Claude Code is signed in (reached over SSH)

settings.name: QUEUE_BIN
settings.description: Folder on that machine with agent-queue, orchestrator.sh and claude-task. Empty: ~/bin

settings.name: QUEUE_HOME
settings.description: The queue's data folder on that machine (AGENT_QUEUE_HOME). Empty: ~/agent-queue

settings.name: RUNNER
settings.description: The command that runs one task (AGENT_QUEUE_RUNNER)

settings.name: STALL_MINUTES
settings.description: Minutes without log output before the stall check treats a task as stalled

settings.name: ISSUE_REPO
settings.description: owner/name of the repository the tasks' issue numbers belong to, to link a task named like fix-login-344 to #344

settings.name: AGENT_BOARDS
settings.description: Boards Pick-up takes issues from, in run order: comma-separated owner/number: Column (for example rzvdaniel/17: Ready for agents, rzvdaniel/2: Ready for agents). Empty: Pick-up queues nothing

settings.name: PAUSE_BETWEEN
settings.description: Pick-up queues nothing in this UTC window, HH:MM-HH:MM (for example 08:00-18:00). Empty: never paused

settings.name: LESSONS_PROMPT
settings.description: The prompt of the lessons job. Empty: work through the lessons inbox with the lessons-learned skill

secrets.name: SSH_KEY
secrets.description: Private key (OpenSSH or PEM, no passphrase) that may sign in as the user in QUEUE_HOST. Use a key made for Overseer, never the production key

secrets.name: ADMIN_TOKEN
secrets.description: At least 16 characters. The schedules use it to call the app; outside Automaton it is the page's login

secrets.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
secrets.description: Read access to the boards named in AGENT_BOARDS and to their repos' issues. Empty: no Pick-up
